```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
library(circlize)

farbenblind15 <- c("#000000","#004949","#009292","#FF6DB6","#FFB6DB",
                  "#490092","#006DDB","#B66DFF","#6DB6FF","#B6DBFF",
                  "#920000","#924900","#DB6D00","#24FF24","#FFFF6D") 

date.colors <- brewer.pal(8, "Set2")
```


```{r Import Data and Aggregate}
# Tcells
Tcells <- readRDS(file = "Tcells_CCAintegration_annotation_TCRs.rds")

Tcells.pseudo <- AggregateExpression(Tcells, assays = "RNA", return.seurat = F, group.by = c("ident", "date"))

head(Tcells.pseudo$RNA)

# Scaling and log transformation of pseudobulk counts to plot cytokine expression over time
# counts -> TP10K
tp10k <- t(t(as.matrix(Tcells.pseudo$RNA)) / colSums(as.matrix(Tcells.pseudo$RNA)))*10000

#log2 transform 
log_tp10k <- log2(tp10k + 1) 

# Selected cytokines Tregs
Treg.cyto <- log_tp10k[c("IL10", "IL17A", "IL26", "CXCL8"), grepl("Treg-1", colnames(log_tp10k))]

colnames(Treg.cyto) <- c("Pre-B", "Post-B", "Pre-CART", "D10", "Mo1", "Mo5", "Mo8")

Heatmap.cols <- colorRamp2(c(0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2,2.25,2.5,2.75), viridis(n = 12))
Cytokines <- Heatmap(Treg.cyto, name = "Gene expression \n(Log-transformed normalized expression)", col = Heatmap.cols, 
        cluster_columns = F, cluster_rows = F, column_title = "Expression of cytokines in Tregs (1)", row_title_rot = 0, 
        row_names_side = "left", column_names_rot = 45)

Cytokines


### z-scored expression
Treg.cyto.zscore <- t(scale(t(Treg.cyto)))

Heatmap.cols <- colorRamp2(c(-1.5,-1.25,-1,-0.75,-0.5,-0.25,0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2), viridis(n = 15))
Cytokines.zscore <- Heatmap(Treg.cyto.zscore, name = "Gene expression \n(z-score of gene expression)", col = Heatmap.cols, 
        cluster_columns = F, cluster_rows = F, column_title = "Expression of cytokines in Tregs (1)", row_title_rot = 0, 
        row_names_side = "left", column_names_rot = 45)

Cytokines.zscore

```
